status: Gate GSP05 (SP05/b tracker circuit breaker), registered before any measured run. Derived from the session draft drafts/gsp05-draft.json (harness parameters unchanged); the draft's median/J rule is replaced, before any run, by pooled means with a seeded bootstrap and Holm correction because gsp02-v1..v3 showed the median/J rule under-estimates noise. Fixed; a new attempt is a new version.
item: SP05/b: C0 = legacy (indexer_breaker_threshold 0) vs C5 = candidate (threshold 2, cooldown 120 s doubling to 600 s; UX frame row 4).

source.manifest_method: sha256 over 'path:git-blob-id' lines of git ls-tree -r HEAD server/app
source.candidate_contents: feature/stream-performance after merging SP05/b and SP06/b (both switched off by default) and the C2 default (5c14f1e); the harness sets the breaker policy in-process

harness.what_is_real: API-key/DB auth, Stremio/provider/repository path, IndexerSearchService (per-tracker timeout, tracker cache, SP05/b breaker), shared source search (singleflight, 15 s deadline, .torrent download/store), Tech Info enrichment, filter/sort/serialization.
harness.what_is_synthetic: tracker adapters (per-indexer latency, timeout, connection error, flapping), .torrent download latency, nCore-like Tech Info stub. No real tracker, account or network; external HTTP is blocked and counted.

runner: scripts/run_sp_search_gate.py: one fresh --network none container per run (cpuset 0,1, 2 CPU, 1 GiB), arms rotated per repetition, sequential; 2 series x 5 repetitions per arm.
time_scale_note: 0.25 scales every duration (12.5 s timeout -> 3.125 s, 15 s deadline -> 3.75 s, cooldowns, latencies, interval, flap periods) except the product's fixed 1.5 s Tech Info budget; reported numbers are unscaled. Estimated wall time ~6 min per legacy arm and ~4 min per candidate arm for S1-S4, ~20 min per repetition incl. container start, ~3.5 h for 2 x 5 repetitions.

decision_rule.statistic: per-run steady-window latency p50/p95 (ms, unscaled); pooled n = 10 runs per arm; difference of means; 10 000 bootstrap resamples, seed 20261110; one-sided p-values; Holm per family at alpha 0.05
pass_if_all: S2 cold steady p50 improves (H0 diff >= 0 rejected)
no S1/S3 guard regression after Holm over 8 tests
identical per-request source digests in S1 and S3 across all runs of both arms
the candidate's breaker never opens in S3 (slow but answering)
descriptive_only: S2 subject search calls per minute
